scripts.text:
[Rina]
Hi~!
You are an adventurer like me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你好~！
你和我一样，也是一名冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am put under a curse.
I know you want to help me,
but your experience is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我中了诅咒。
我知道你想帮我，
但你的经验值还不够。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am not in the good condition,
so what I can do for you
is just like this.
Then, good bye.
Take care~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我现在状态不太好，
所以能为你做的
也就只有这些了。
那么，再见。
保重~！

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Hi~!
You are an adventurer like me.
Well... In fact, I am
put under a strange curse.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你好~！
你和我一样，也是一名冒险者。
嗯...其实，我中了
一种奇怪的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
To release this curse,
somebody needs to do ^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000
with me,
and then needs to solve
several problems instead of me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
要解除这个诅咒，
需要有人和我进行^800080宣誓仪式^000000，
然后代替我解决
几个问题。

scripts.text: Let's help ^800080Rina^000000.
Just skip it.
scripts.translation: 直接跳过。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
To help me,
I need a competent adventurer.
If you know those people,
I hope you to introduce them to me later.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
要帮我，
我需要一名有能力的冒险者。
如果你认识这样的人，
希望之后能介绍给我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Are you really going to help me?
Thank you.
You are so brave.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你真的要帮我吗？
谢谢你。
你真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Then I'll start ^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000.
 
^787878( A mysterious atmosphere hangs in the air. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
那么我开始^800080宣誓仪式^000000了。
 
^787878（空气中弥漫着神秘的氛围。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Blah blah blah...
 
Blah blah blah...
 
^787878( ... This is a strange spell. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
巴拉巴拉...
 
巴拉巴拉...
 
^787878（...这是一种奇怪的咒语。）^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Haaaaah~
^800080Oath-taking ceremony^000000 is done enough now.
Isn't that so simple?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
哈啊~
^800080宣誓仪式^000000差不多完成了。
是不是很简单？

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Okay, from no on,
you need to go on ^006400a real adventure
to release my curse^000000.
Let me know when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
好了，从现在开始，
你需要去^006400进行真正的冒险
来解除我的诅咒^000000。
准备好了就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
What you need to do is
to choose one monster among
^FF0000DEVIRUCHI,^000000 ^FF0000WRAITH DEAD,^000000
^FF0000DULLAHAN,^000000 ^FF0000NIGHTMARE TERROR^000000
and then kill ^0000FF50^000000 monsters
and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你要做的是
从^FF0000小恶魔^000000、^FF0000狂暴恶灵^000000、
^FF0000无颅武士^000000、^FF0000七彩梦魇^000000中
选择一种魔物，
然后击杀^0000FF50^000000只并回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
It must be a tough task,
but you are the right person
who did the oath-taking ceremony.
I hope you succeed.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
这一定是个艰巨的任务，
但你是那个完成了宣誓仪式的人。
我希望你能成功。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You did it.
I can feel that my body is recovering.
But it is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你做到了。
我能感觉到我的身体正在恢复。
但还不够。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
^006400You have one more thing to do.^000000
Let me know when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
^006400你还有一件事要做。^000000
准备好了就告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I will check one thing.
For this task,
You need to feel the music.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我要检查一件事。
对于这项任务，
你需要能听到音乐。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You cannot complete the task
without the music.
do you have any problem?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
没有音乐
你无法完成任务。
你有任何问题吗？

scripts.text:
- Check! -
^787878- BGM option should be turned on -^000000
^787878- in the game option menu. -^000000
^787878- Please check -^000000
^787878- whether you can listen -^000000
^787878- to the music sound. -^000000
[I'm ready to listen to the BGM.]
scripts.translation: [我准备好听背景音乐了。]

scripts.text: [I can't listen to the BGM.]
scripts.translation: [我听不到背景音乐。]

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I am so shocked that
you cannot feel the music.
What should we do now...
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你竟然听不到音乐，
这让我很震惊。
现在该怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Listen carefully
the feelings of it...
I can't hear it,
but you can hear the sound.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
仔细聆听
它的感觉...
我听不见，
但你能听到声音。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
^006400The music you're hearing now^000000
has something to do with the one specific city.
Think carefully ^006400what kind of city^000000
has similar feeling with this music.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
^006400你现在听到的音乐^000000
与某个特定的城市有关。
仔细想想，^006400什么样的城市^000000
与这段音乐的感觉相似。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
And...
Go to ^006400the city
where you can remind by this music^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
然后...
前往^006400能被这段音乐唤起回忆的城市^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
After that,
find ^FF0000the strange mark^000000
around the entrances of the city.
Then you can release the curse on me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
之后，
在城市的入口附近
寻找^FF0000奇怪的标记^000000。
这样你就能解除我身上的诅咒了。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
It must be tough
but I hope you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
这一定很困难，
但我祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
You're back~!
My curse has been released.
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你回来了~！
我的诅咒已经解除了。
非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Your bag is too full.
I have a present for you
so make your bag lighter.
I'll wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
你的背包太满了。
我有礼物要送给你，
所以请清理一下背包。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
This is the present for you.
It's not a big one
but please take it
as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
这是送给你的礼物。
虽然不算贵重，
但请收下，
作为我的一点心意。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
I'll take a rest for a few days
and then I'll go on an adventure.
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
我要休息几天，
然后继续去冒险。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Rina]
Thank you for releasing my curse.
I'll take a rest for a few days
and then go on an adventure again.
Have a happy day~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜]
谢谢你解除了我的诅咒。
我要休息几天，
然后再去冒险。
祝你愉快~！

scripts.text: - I found ^0000FFthe strange mark^000000. -
scripts.translation: - 我找到了^0000FF奇怪的标记^000000。 -

scripts.text:
- I can definitely feel that
- ^0000FFRina^000000 has been released
- from the curse.
- ^006400Let's go back to Rina!^000000
scripts.translation:
- 我确实感觉到
- ^0000FF莉娜^000000身上的诅咒
- 已经解除了。
- ^006400让我们回到莉娜那里吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
.......
 
^787878( No response. )^000000

[Rina's Little Friend]
Hi.
I guess you're the trustworthy friend.
Are you here to make a deal with me?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
你好。
我想你就是那个值得信赖的朋友。
你是来和我做交易的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Hmm.
The material is not enough.
Please check the things you need.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
嗯。
材料不够。
请检查你需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Cool... if you give me the materials
I will start it right now.
Are you ready for it?
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
酷...如果你给我材料，
我现在就开始。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, let's start it.
scripts.translation: 是的，开始吧。

scripts.text: No, stop it.
scripts.translation: 不，停下。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Heh. It's boring.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
呵。真无聊。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Okay, I will start it now.
 
^787878( A mysterious atmosphere hangs in the air. )^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
好的，我现在就开始了。
 
^787878( 空气中弥漫着一种神秘的气氛。 )^000000

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Life is given to the egg.
Aaaaah~ I got to take some rest.
Good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
生命已经赋予了这颗蛋。
啊哈~ 我得休息一下了。
再见~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
It seems that you have quite interesting things.
I need to take some rest.
Good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
看来你有一些挺有趣的东西。
我得休息一下了。
再见~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
There was no change.
I didn't mean to do it,
but I'm sorry...
I hope to see you again, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
没有任何变化。
我不是故意的，
但我很抱歉...
希望下次还能见到你，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Hmm.
It became a dish.
Looks delicious.
Then, good bye~!
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
嗯。
它变成了一道菜。
看起来很好吃。
那么，再见~！

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
You are here just to see my cute looks?
Aren't you peeking at Rina
pretending to see me?
It's funny... haha~
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
你只是来欣赏我可爱的外表吗？
难道你是在偷看莉娜，
却假装在看我吗？
真有趣... 哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Huh?!
I never told you before?
Then listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
咦？！
我之前没告诉过你吗？
那你仔细听好了。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
I have a
special ability.
It's to give a special strength
to ^0000FFthe egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
我拥有一种
特殊的能力。
那就是赋予^0000FF蛋^000000特殊的强化。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Well, I cannot do that unlimitedly.
There is no magic that is done forever.
So I need some additional cost.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
嗯，我不能无限次地使用这种能力。
没有永远有效的魔法。
所以我需要额外的代价。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
And I cannot sure
to what the egg will be changed.
It may be end in failure
and it can be something like Pet Egg.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
而且我也无法确定
蛋会变成什么。
它可能会失败，
或者变成像宠物蛋之类的东西。

scripts.text: Ask the cost.
scripts.translation: 询问代价。

scripts.text: Stop listening because it feels like a trick.
scripts.translation: 不听，感觉像是个陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Well... I don't really care.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
嗯... 我其实不太在意。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B400,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
你想达成交易吗？
你需要
^0000FF1个蛋^000000、^0000FF20个光粒^000000 以及
^B8860B400,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B450,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B480,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
Do you want to make a deal?
You need
^0000FF1 Egg^000000, ^0000FF20 Light Granule^000000 and
^B8860B500,000 Zeny^000000.

[Rina's Little Friend]
If you are interested
make that zeny and come again.
Haha...
I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
如果你感兴趣的话，
就去准备那些Zeny，然后再来吧。
哈哈...
我会等着你的。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
Ahem!
Why? Are you surprised to see me speaking?
Well, I understand you.
Only the person who did
the oath-taking ceremony can talk with me.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
咳！
为什么？你对我说话感到惊讶吗？
嗯，我理解你。
只有进行过
宣誓仪式的人才能与我交谈。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
If Rina's curse is released,
I can also
suggest you
an interesting thing.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
如果莉娜的诅咒解除了，
我也能
向你推荐
一件有趣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Rina's Little Friend]
I will let you know
the detailed explanation later.
Then see you later, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[莉娜的小伙伴]
稍后我会告诉你
详细的说明。
那么，再见了，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I'm a traveler
and I often visit ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Hmm, I think I might
see you around here before.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我是个旅行者，
经常造访^8B4513普隆德拉^000000。
嗯，我想我可能
之前在这里见过你。

scripts.text: Listen some more.
scripts.translation: 再听一会儿

scripts.text: Just ignore it.
scripts.translation: 直接无视

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
As I expected,
you are a silent person. Ha ha.
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
果然，
你是个沉默寡言的人。哈哈。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
A few days ago,
I saw a new adventurer
who were standing
near the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
几天前，
我看到一个新冒险者
站在^8B4513大教堂^000000附近。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That adventurer seemed pretty.
But...
I feel some strange energy
so I don't come close to that person.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那个冒险者看起来很漂亮。
但是...
我感到一股奇怪的能量，
所以不敢靠近那个人。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Look like
you're interested in
that new adventurer?
Or that is just your face look. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
看起来
你对那个新冒险者很感兴趣？
或者那只是你的表情。哈哈。

scripts.text: I'm interested in it.
scripts.translation: 我对此很感兴趣

scripts.text: I don't care at all.
scripts.translation: 我完全不在乎

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Ah~ I see~!
Then, Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
啊~ 原来如此~！
那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Just as I expected!
You can find
that new adventurer
on the way to the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000
at the direction of 1o'clock in ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
正如我所料！
你可以在^8B4513普隆德拉^000000
1点钟方向的通往^8B4513大教堂^000000的路上
找到那个新冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
She was carrying
^800080a big egg thing^000000.
That's what I know.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
她抱着
^800080一个巨大的蛋状物^000000。
这就是我所知道的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
A while ago,
I met a lady
and she said she has been
under a strange curse.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不久前，
我遇到了一位女士，
她说自己受到了
奇怪的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I wanted to help her
but my experience is not enough.
So I couldn't help her.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我想帮助她，
但我的经验值不够。
所以我没能帮到她。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are more than
level ^0000FF40^000000,
go to the ^8B4513Cathedral^000000
at the direction of 1'o clock.
I hope you can help her...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
如果你的等级超过
^0000FF40^000000级，
请前往1点钟方向的^8B4513大教堂^000000。
希望你能帮助她...
